d:
FSSAI has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International after laboratory testing declared a sample of its packaged drinking water unsafe, raising questions about the quality and safety of bottled water sold in India.
The initial test detected bromate above the prescribed limit, while subsequent testing by a referral laboratory detected polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons, or PAHs. Bisleri has disputed the findings, maintained that its water is safe for consumption and cited independent laboratory tests that found bromate levels within permissible limits.
